title: THE HEAVY FUEL CAN AND SHIN GUARDS ARE CHIPPED
why: Art build step b, the last Heavy set pieces (his pick: Refined Chibi with Gear-heavy raider). The Fuel Can Pack gets a scheme colour panel stripe and three bare steel paint chips; the Shin Guards get two steel chips on each plate. Everything stays inside the old outline, so no anchor moves.
now: The Heavy fuel can and shin guards now show chipped paint and a colour stripe.
